messages:
anya (product): quick one — competitor just shipped a 1-click 'context-aware prompts' feature that maps to our customizable prompt pipelines. customers are asking if we can match parity quickly. need ideas: quick parity shim vs double-down on a differentiator that makes their feature irrelevant. input pls.
benji (pm): can we do a parity MVP in one sprint? probably a feature-flagged router + prompt template UI. lean implementation: no eval infra yet.
mohit (eng): engineering estimate: parity-mvp ~3 dev-weeks (1 eng + 0.5 infra) if we reuse current template storage. main risk: runtime routing complexity + test coverage.
lee (design): for MVP we can reuse existing template UX but add a tiny wizard. won't be polished but usable. mock in 2 days.
olivia (sales): customers asking for parity + SLA on consistency. If we ship parity fast we buy breathing room for sales. big customers will still ask for perf/cost comparison.
dana (research): quick experiment: measure how much value users get from 'context-aware prompts' vs just better default templates. small user study could be done in 1 week.
rebecca (cto): strategic note: parity is tactical. we should evaluate a differentiator that maps to our platform thesis — e.g., 'predictable low-cost serving' or 'multi-model rollouts with automatic quality fallback'. which of those can we prototype fast?
benji (pm): propose 2-track approach: Track A (parity-mvp, short): enable mapping + UI + canary. Track B (differentiator, med): automated rollout + fallback that avoids hallucination regressions. allocate 2 engineers to A, 1 to B.
mohit (eng): ack but infra needs for B are non-trivial (model routing + metric hooks). estimate 4-6 sprints for a solid B. we can deliver a tiny demo earlier.
anya (product): launch criteria for parity-mvp suggestion:
```
- implements mapping of competitor's 3 core behaviors
- user can save templates and assign to routes
- ability to toggle parity feature per-tenant
- smoke tests: response format + latency within 2x baseline
- documented fallback plan (can disable)
```
lee (design): will draft the wizard and microcopy for the toggle. also design a 'why this matters' tooltip for sales decks.
olivia (sales): for go/no-go we need a one-pager with positioning: "fast parity" vs "we'll measure quality over time". I can draft and push to key reps.
dana (research): recommend running the week-long A/B in staging targeting existing beta customers — metric: % of tasks where templates improve success rate by 10%+.
rebecca (cto): decision call: move forward with A (parity-mvp) but cap scope: no full eval infra yet. also greenlight 1-week research run and a tiny B prototype (demo) so we can show roadmap differentiation.
anya (product): OK agreed. next steps: 
- benji: write PRD for parity-mvp by EOD tomorrow
- mohit: allocate dev and infra tickets, blocker list by EOD
- lee: mocks in 48h
- dana: experiment plan in 24h
- olivia: draft sales one-pager by end of week
rebecca (cto): i'll unblock infra priorities if any of you surface dependency tickets.
deploy-bot: deployment scheduled: feature-flag scaffold created on branch feature/parity-mvp (CI ticked).
anya (product): thanks team — we'll sync in tom's weekly for approvals. :thumbsup:
